competences.description: Removes 1 harmful effect granted on the Boss every time the crystal is attacked.When the Water Crystal is activated in the battlefield, damage from Water-attribute attacks increases by 50%, and damage from Fire-attribute attacks decreases by 25%.In addition, the crystal's HP will not decrease. If it receives an attack that is not a Glancing Hit, its attribute will change according to the number of hits.

Decreases the Defense of the target that attacked the crystal for 2 turns.When the Fire Crystal is activated in the battlefield, damage from Fire-attribute attacks increases by 50%, and damage from Wind-attribute attacks decreases by 25%.In addition, the crystal's HP will not decrease. If it receives an attack that is not a Glancing Hit, its attribute will change according to the number of hits.

Increases the Boss's Attack Bar by 10% every time the crystal is attacked.When the Wind Crystal is activated in the battlefield, damage from Wind-attribute attacks increases by 50%, and damage from Water-attribute attacks decreases by 25%.In addition, the crystal's HP will not decrease. If it receives an attack that is not a Glancing Hit, its attribute will change according to the number of hits.
